evidence: Nestled within the Trống Đồng building of the Vietnam Museum of Ethnology, the exhibition area dedicated to ethnic musical instruments stands as a testament to the rich cultural heritage of Vietnam’s fifty-four ethnic groups. Since the museum’s inception, this collection has been meticulously assembled from various regions across the country, serving as a living archive that preserves the soulful essence of each community.
